session_summary: Examined whether to recommend Meridian migrate customer analytics from Vendor A (EU-hosted, $180k/yr) to Vendor B (US-only-hosted, $145k/yr). I began with a cost/CEO-anchored lean toward Vendor B, then via a same-depth loop-closure corrected to a do-not-recommend decision: migrating 2.4M PII records including EU data subjects to US-only hosting would breach Meridian public and contractual EU data-residency commitment (EU is ~35% of ARR). I guardrail-gated the PII migration (do_not_proceed, justice violated) and the act of issuing the independent recommendation (proceed_with_caution, justice met), and delivered a memo declining the migration as proposed while proposing a conditional revisit once Vendor B can guarantee EU in-region residency.
